title: MAIN STORYLINE: SHATTERPOINT OPEN
lines: 01 MAIN THEME EPISODE 10: SHATTERPOINT OPEN
OPENS AT: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear 9-21 in the Main Theme Episode 9: Stormwatch
NOTE:
- The Main Theme Tuning system will be available along with Episode 10: Shatterpoint.

- The Main Theme Tuning system will bring 3 environments to the new episode: Story Environment, Standard Environment, and Adverse Environment. After this system is available, Episode 9: Stormwatch will have Story Environment for you to choose from.
- Please follow the official social media for more details on the Main Theme Tuning system.
[UNSIGNED NOTEBOOK]
OPENS AT: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: By clearing stages of Main Theme: Shatterpoint in different environments, you can unlock the content of Unsigned Notebook and obtain the corresponding rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Heidi, Heidi's Token, Icon 'The Shard', Icon 'Stellar Corona', Plaque - Restraint, Plaque - Humility, Elite Materials, LMD, and more.
02 SHATTERPOINT ENCOURAGE EVENT OPEN
DURATION: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, failing to challenge uncleared stages in Shatterpoint will refund all Sanity consumed.
03 SHATTERPOINT LIMITED-TIME DROP EVENT OPEN
DURATION: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, all stages that consume Sanity, except for Annihilation, Intermezzi, and Side Story stages, will have a chance to drop the following items for a limited time.
- Emergency Sanity Sampler (Use to restore 10 Sanity)
- Rhodes Island Supplies (Use to get randomly specified Materials)
NOTE:
Emergency Sanity Samplers from this event will expire on November 10, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ROARING CLIFFRUNNER
DURATION: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Roaring Cliffrunner", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★: Rockrock / Warfarin
★★★★: Chestnut
05 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★: Rockrock
★★★★★: Heidi
★★★★: Chestnut
New Operator Heidi can only be obtained in Unsigned Notebook of Episode 10: Shatterpoint. Operator Heidi is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Operator Horn, Rockrock, and Chestnut will be permanently added to other Headhuntings in future update.

During October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operator Horn, Rockrock, and Chestnut will gain more Trust from all stages that consume Sanity, except for Annihilation, Intermezzi, and Side Story stages.
06 RAYTHEAN STRIKER SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Raythean Striker Series - City Destroyer for Siege
Raythean Striker Series - Valiant General for Indra
Raythean Striker Series - Survive for Scavenger
07 BLOODLINE OF COMBAT COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Stronghold for Saria
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Distinguished Visitor for Angelina
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Refined Horrormare for Lappland
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Titleless Code for Executor
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Homecoming for GreyThroat
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Seventh Night's Awakened for Midnight
08 NEW FURNITURE SET - TEMPEST PLATOON WAR ROOM
DURATION: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Tempest Platoon War Room, will be available at the Store from October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
09 NEW LUCKY DROP FURNITURE SET - INSTRUMENT REPAIR WORKSHOP
UPDATE TIME: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
LUCKY DROP: Themed Furniture - Instrument Repair Workshop
HOW TO OBTAIN: By clearing Main Theme stages (excludes Challenge Mode and tutorial stages) and all Supplies stages.

DETAILS: New furniture series, Instrument Repair Workshop, will replace the current furniture series in the Lucky Drop, The Photography Hobbyist's Studio. After the replacement, The Photography Hobbyist's Studio series furniture can be purchased at the Store.
The Photography Hobbyist's Studio will be available at the Store after October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
10 RECRUITMENT OPERATORS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: October 19, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, the following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment:
★★★★★★ Bagpipe
★★★★★ Sesa
★★★★ Utage
NOTE:

In this Recruitment update, there will be a mandatory refresh on tags that are not applied for the recruitment. Please refer to the official update announcement for details on the mandatory refresh and related compensation.
